scope: Structural graph and eligibility audit only; no empirical outcome frequencies, event rates, hazard/survival curves, hypothesis comparison or favorable window selection.
known_before_freeze: Source dictionary and published exclusions, four394x243 array dimensions, event codes0/1, 30-minute interval, codebook49h/frame98 vs methods50h. Cell-level graph topology and structural error counts have not been calculated.
rules: Parse original XML numeric cells without altering raw source; require all four arrays to match dimensions and expected source hashes.
At each frame, group rows by nonzero Lineage label. Compare annotations and masks within each same-label group; repeated ancestral rows are not independent cells.

Build deterministic adjacent-frame candidate edges from nonzero label transitions on original rows. Record mergers, renames, bifurcations, excess offspring, partial arrivals/departures and unmatched divisions; do not repair.

Construct candidate cell episodes across one-to-one same-label transitions; start new episodes at splits, renames, mergers and roots. Source label alone is not a persistent biological-cell identifier.

Check division indicators against split boundaries at the prior and new frames separately, and death annotations against tracking-mask transitions without assigning a biological time convention by assumption.
Separate observed initial roots, delayed roots, roots with partial ancestry and components touched by ambiguity. Preserve original exclusion labels separately from algorithmic structural flags.

Assess algorithmic feasibility of equal-probability future-blind daughter choice only at source-supported binary splits; do not sample endpoint-surviving ancestries or condition branch choice on future fate.
Assess horizon-invariance feasibility using one fixed founder roster, time origin and observation process; do not choose horizons or calculate Q_T curves in this audit.
output_boundary: Public original code and aggregate structural checks only; source-row/frame/cell-level candidate graphs and issue lists stay in ignored tmp.
verification: Deterministic graph invariants, small hand-constructed structural fixtures, exact source hash checks and repeat-run identity. No biomedical-rate tests.
